text:
Priya Rao: Quick sync — Veridian renewal is moving to procurement. They want a 9mo term instead of 12, and finance asked for proration on the final invoice. Can ops help with the SOW update?
Marco Diaz: Got it. Do we have a PO number yet? If not procurement will hold the Docusign.
Evelyn Chen: They emailed a tentative PO: PO-88219, but vendor code is missing. Procurement needs vendor code or they won't process.
Samir Patel: Hi team — onboarding flagged a billing entity mismatch too. Legal will need to confirm signatory authority for the shortened term. Tagging @LegalBot to confirm process.
LegalBot: FYI: For term reductions we need an exec-signed amendment + updated SOW. Otherwise legal won't approve the net-change.
Priya Rao: Can we template the amendment? If finance accepts proration we can attach a single line item: "9mo pro-rated subscription" and the delta credit.
Marco Diaz: Finance needs the exact math. Sample proration calc would help. Example we sent: 
```
Annual: $120,000
9mo charge = 120000 * 9/12 = $90,000
Prorate credit = 120000 - 90000 = $30,000 (applied to final invoice)
```
Evelyn Chen: That calc is fine. Procurement also wants payment terms: they prefer Net60. Does that block anything?
Samir Patel: Net60 is okay but we need to flag for rev recognition and collections. I'll loop in billing if we agree.
Priya Rao: Next blockers: vendor code + signature path. Marco can you confirm whether we can accept the PO without vendor code if they provide wire instructions?
Marco Diaz: Short answer: procurement says no. Long answer: we can accept an exception but need written approval from procurement lead (Maya). I can ping her.
Priya Rao: Please ping. Evelyn — can you prepare the amendment draft (one-pager) and SOW patch with the proration line and Net60 note? Use the standard amendment template and mark change reason: "term-shortening per customer request".
Evelyn Chen: On it. ETA 2 hours. Will include a Docusign link when ready.
Priya Rao: Great. Marco — once Maya gives procurement exception, can you get vendor code or exception note into the PO system?
Marco Diaz: I'll escalate now and update thread.
Samir Patel: Also, small ops note: if they want KMS key rotation managed by customer, add KMS clause. Procurement asked earlier if we require HSM — nothing new but flag it.
Priya Rao: Good catch — include that as an optional appendix.
LegalBot: Draft amendment should include sign-off block for both parties and a line about billing entity to avoid the mismatch.
Evelyn Chen: Draft uploaded: https://redwood.app/drafts/veridian-amend-4951234567 (Docusign to follow).
Marco Diaz: Procurement responded — will accept PO-88219 provisionally if vendor code submitted within 3 business days. Asked for Maya's sign-off; she said she'll approve the exception by EOD.
Priya Rao: Perfect. Once procurement confirms vendor code or exception and Docusign is sent, I'll coordinate with customer success to confirm deployment windows and renewal date.
Samir Patel: One more: capture customer feedback on why they shortened term (ops notes). We should add to account health: cause = "budget timing shift".
Priya Rao: Noted. I'll add that to the renewal notes and to the enablement plan.
Evelyn Chen: Docusign envelope created: https://docusign.example/envelope/0a1b2c (sent).
Marco Diaz: Maya approved the exception and will add vendor code. Procurement will post vendor code by tomorrow morning.
Priya Rao: Thanks all. I'll mark this as "awaiting vendor code + signature" and will ping sales if anything slips. :thumbsup:
Marco Diaz: Thanks — keeping an eye.
Samir Patel: Adding billing to follow-up.
Priya Rao: Closing loop later today after signature.
